name: Stellenbosch Wine Festival (Wine Town Stellenbosch)
description: Flagship walk-around tasting at the historic Stellenbosch Town Hall, featuring 60+ Stellenbosch wine producers. The headline event of the week-long Wine Town Stellenbosch celebration with gourmet small plates and top local wines.

name: Capitec Franschhoek Cap Classique & Champagne Festival
description: South Africa's premier sparkling wine festival at the foot of the Huguenot Monument, celebrating Méthode Cap Classique and Champagne producers. A glamorous weekend of bubbly, food, and live entertainment.

name: Franschhoek Bastille Festival
description: French-inspired winter celebration in the heart of Franschhoek village at the Hospice grounds, featuring wine and cheese tastings, live entertainment, and a marquee weekend honouring the valley's Huguenot heritage.

name: Franschhoek Uncorked Festival
description: Spring wine festival bidding farewell to winter and celebrating the new vintage across participating Franschhoek Wine Valley estates. A weekend pass grants access to tastings, food pairings, and live music at multiple farms.

name: Swartland Revolution
description: Boutique, high-end reunion of the iconic Swartland wine movement, featuring seminars, spectacular Chenin Blanc and Rhône-style wines, and cuisine from top chefs. A limited-capacity weekend celebrating the Swartland's independent producers.

name: Robertson Wacky Wine Weekend
description: The Robertson Wine Valley's signature winter festival with 50+ wineries offering meet-the-winemaker tastings, vineyard tractor trips, river cruises, and live music. A weekend passport includes tasting coupons and access to all participating cellars.

name: Sip & Savour @ The River (Robertson)
description: Spring wine, cuisine, and culture festival on the banks of the Breede River, formerly known as Robertson Wine on the River. Features complimentary tastings from all participating Robertson Wine Valley estates at Viljoensdrift.

name: Hermanus Wine & Food Festival
description: Walker Bay's premier wine show at the Curro grounds in Sandbaai, consistently voted one of South Africa's Top 10 wine shows. Showcases local wineries and winemakers alongside gourmet food vendors, with a crystal tasting glass included.

name: Celebration of Pinot Noir & Chardonnay (Hemel-en-Aarde)
description: Annual celebration of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay in the heart of the Hemel-en-Aarde Valley. Powered by Yoco, the event gathers top cool-climate producers for a day of world-class tastings and food pairings.

name: Pick n Pay Wine & Food Festival (Cape Town)
description: Major urban wine and food festival at the Constantia Sports Complex, bringing together leading Western Cape producers with gourmet food stalls, picnic bags, and a dedicated Pick n Pay Wine Club offering.
venueName: Claremont Cricket Club, Constantia Sports Complex

name: Constantia Fresh
description: Annual September tasting event in South Africa's oldest wine region, where the six premium Constantia estates showcase their celebrated Sauvignon Blancs and other cool-climate wines in an intimate valley setting.

name: TOPS at SPAR Wine Show (Johannesburg)
description: South Africa's largest travelling try-and-buy wine show, held at Montecasino in Johannesburg. Consumers can taste and purchase wines from dozens of Western Cape producers and attend the popular Wine Theatre tastings.

name: Standard Bank WineX
description: Johannesburg's premier annual wine festival at the Sandton Convention Centre, where the best of the Cape comes to Jozi for three nights of walk-around tastings. One of the most vibrant indoor wine events on the South African calendar.

name: Cape Winemakers Guild Auction
description: South Africa's most prestigious wine auction, featuring small-batch wines crafted exclusively by members of the Cape Winemakers Guild. Now in its 41st year, it attracts bidders from over a dozen countries.

name: Cape Wine Auction
description: One of the world's most prestigious charity wine auctions, described as a rockstar party for a good cause. Hosted at Nederburg, the 2026 edition raised over R10 million for education and wine-community beneficiaries in the Cape Winelands.

name: Calitzdorp Expressed (Port & Wine Festival)
description: Annual winter port and wine festival in the Klein Karoo capital of South African port-style wines. Formerly the Absa Calitzdorp Port & Wine Festival, it features port and wine tastings, vintage tractor displays, live music, and gourmet street food.

name: Tulbagh Christmas in Winter Festival
description: Beloved winter wine festival where the entire Tulbagh valley comes together to celebrate a Christmas-themed weekend. Features wine tastings across valley estates, a Christmas-decorated village, art and crafts, traditional dinners, and live entertainment.

name: Elgin Cool Vines Expedition
description: Distinctive cool-climate wine, food, and live music experience at Oak Valley Estate, celebrating the Elgin Wine Route's premium Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Noir, and Chardonnay. A full-day expedition through one of South Africa's coolest wine regions.

name: Elgin Cool Wine & Country Food Festival
description: Celebrating its 10th year, this festival combines the cool-climate wines of the Elgin Valley (Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Noir, Chardonnay) with country food across multiple participating estates in the Kogelberg Biosphere.

name: RMB Simonsberg Wine Festival
description: Boutique festival at Plaisir Wine Estate celebrating the world-class wines of the Simonsberg region near Simondium. Over 40 wines available for tasting, with tickets including tasting coupons, a souvenir glass, and a bag.

name: Pinotage 100 Celebration at Meerendal
description: Four-day celebration of 100 years of Pinotage, South Africa's signature grape, hosted at historic Meerendal Wine Estate in Durbanville. An unforgettable centenary commemoration honouring a century of heritage, excellence, and innovation.

name: Pinotage 100 Festival Pretoria
description: Centenary Pinotage celebration hosted by Liquid Art, Pretoria Country Club, and the Pinotage Association. A gala showcase of South Africa's heritage grape marking 100 years since its creation.

name: Knysna Fine Wine Festival
description: Flagship wine event of the Knysna Oyster Festival, pairing local wines with the region's famous oysters. Held over two days with multiple tasting sessions at Loerie Park, it's a highlight of the 10-day winter school holiday festival.

name: Knysna Oyster Festival
description: Iconic 10-day winter family festival on the Garden Route, combining sport, gastronomy, art, culture, and entertainment. Famous for oyster cooking and shucking events alongside sport challenges and wine tastings.

name: Mellasat Harvest Festival
description: Family-friendly harvest celebration at Mellasat Vineyards in Paarl, marking the grape harvest season with vineyard activities, grape stomping, harvest fare, and tastings of the estate's flagship wines.

name: Taste of Terroir - Durbanville Winter Red Wine Soirée
description: Intimate winter red wine tasting soirée hosted by the Durbanville Wine Valley at Loch Lynne Wine Estate, celebrating the region's 200-year winemaking heritage with curated tastings of cool-climate reds.

name: Elgin Winter Wine Festival
description: Cool-climate winter wine festival where the Elgin Valley comes alive with wine tastings, live music, and seasonal food across participating Kogelberg Biosphere estates.

name: The Cap Classique Affair
description: Annual gathering that brings together South Africa's leading Méthode Cap Classique producers for one sparkling celebration, held in early November to coincide with the post-harvest release of new MCC vintages.

name: Franschhoek Literary Festival
description: Celebration of words and wine in Franschhoek's main street, featuring author talks, book launches, and wine experiences from partners like Porcupine Wines at the main festival hub. Special sessions include Family Stories in Wine.

name: Nederburg Unlocks the Vault Long Table Wine Experience
description: Once-in-a-lifetime long table wine experience at Nederburg Wine Estate for collectors and enthusiasts, featuring rare library vintages and curated pairings in an historic Paarl cellar setting.

name: Cap Classique Day (National Celebration)
description: National celebration of South Africa's Méthode Cap Classique sparkling wines, observed annually on 1 September. Estates across the Western Cape host special tastings and new MCC releases to mark the occasion.

name: International Pinotage Day
description: Worldwide celebration of South Africa's signature grape, observed annually on the second Saturday of October. Wineries across the Western Cape host special tastings, vertical flights, and food pairings to mark the occasion.

name: Constantia Comes to the City
description: Urban tasting event on the NASDAK Rooftop in Cape Town, bringing the six Constantia valley estates to the city centre with a signature wine glass to take home and panoramic views of the CBD.

name: Sauvignon Blanc SA Top 10 & Technical Day
description: Annual industry showcase by Sauvignon Blanc South Africa featuring the FNB Sauvignon Blanc SA Top 10 competition results, a seminar, AGM, and Technical Information Day highlighting regional diversity from Coastal to Cape South Coast.
